usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.responses.input_items.list("response_id", limit: 20, order: "asc", after: "after", include: ["file_search_call.results"])
pp result

typeReference.signature: client.responses.input_items.list(response_id, limit: nil, order: nil, after: nil, include: nil) -> Page<Models::ItemResource>

fields.name: limit
fields.description:
A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between
1 and 100, and the default is 20.

fields.name: order
fields.description:
The order to return the input items in. Default is `desc`.
- `asc`: Return the input items in ascending order.
- `desc`: Return the input items in descending order.

fields.name: after
fields.description: An item ID to list items after, used in pagination.

fields.name: include
fields.description:
Additional fields to include in the response. See the `include`
parameter for Response creation above for more information.
